title: Version scoring rules so old scores verify; gate rule changes on history
summary: Retry of job 20261017-111119-m988: bump the scoring rules to v2 so a bound-only cost is provisional only under v2, recompute older scores under the rules string they carry, and add a mechanism that checks scoring changes against full history. Audience: maintainers and CI, who need `athena check --history` to pass on PR #129 with no record edited.

defaults_applied.how: All changes are Rust code and tests.
Criterion requires cargo test, clippy and fmt --check to pass, with new tests for the new behavior.
Behavior criteria name runnable commands so the verifier can exercise them.
Criteria check that old scores verify and that a changed rule under an unchanged version fails, not that wiring exists.
The history check on scoring changes is a test or xtask ci step, not prose.
The history guard must not pass silently when it checked zero scores or found no repository.
Versioned rules fix the cause (rules changing under old records), not only the 8 files.
The decision is recorded with alternatives in docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md for outside readers.
The evidence-recording run-stage feature is left out as a separate change.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The typed request (retry the rejected job) takes precedence over the introspection's proposed new request; building pre-handover command-evidence recording in the run stage is a separate change and is not done here.
The earlier rejection was only a missing-evidence finding for the cargo test/clippy/fmt criterion, so the earlier design (v1->v2 rules, per-version recompute, history guard, decision record) is kept.
The producer must actually run cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check at the end and report the command lines, exit codes and output tails, so the verifier can cite them.
The test helper landing_with_bound_cost in crates/athena-gate/src/landing_tests.rs is a legitimate deliverable this time.
The history guard test should fail, not silently pass, when it cannot find the git repository or HEAD in CI, or must say plainly that it checked nothing.

acceptance_criteria.text: A scorer test shows the same job records score a bound-only cost as provisional under the current (v2) rules string and not provisional under the v1 rules string. Run `cargo test -p athena-score`.

A gate test shows a score file stamped with the v1 rules string, whose cost was a bound, passes the score-follows-records check. A second test shows a v2 score with a wrong provisional flag is rejected, and an unknown rules string is still refused. Run `cargo test -p athena-gate`.

`cargo run -p athena-cli -- check --history` (or the repository's equivalent) over the real repository reports no violation for the 8 existing score files, including records/jobs/2026-10/20261013-141005-hrdp/score.json. `git diff` shows no file under records/ modified. Run `git diff --stat` and the check.
New scores are written under a bumped v2 rules string. The gate recomputes each score under the rules string it carries.

A mechanism makes a scoring change get checked against full history. A test or an xtask ci step recomputes every historical score with the working-tree scorer, and a test shows it fails when a rule changes under an unchanged version. The guard fails or states it checked nothing when git or HEAD is missing instead of passing silently, and the CI workflow runs it. Run `cargo test` and `cargo run -p xtask -- ci`.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass. The producer's handover quotes each command line, its exit status and its output tail as evidence.
docs/decisions.md records the call (versioned rules over rewriting history or exempting records) with alternatives, and CHANGELOG.md notes the rules version bump.

out_of_scope: Recording command evidence in the run stage before handover (the introspection's proposed new feature); separate change.
Editing or regenerating any file under records/.
Exempting old records from the gate.
departures: Larger than the reference: the change spans scorer, gate, xtask, CI and docs, and a prior attempt was rejected.
